versions.changelog:
Initial release of ashareskill – a professional tool for A-share stock K-line data and technical indicators.

- Provides K-line data (daily/weekly/monthly) and full set of technical indicators (MA, MACD, KDJ, RSI, BOLL, CCI, etc.) for individual stocks or stock pools.
- Supports custom date range, querying by stock name or code, and fetching index constituent stocks.
- Outputs all data in a single CSV file.
- Usable both as a command line script and as a Python module.
- Includes clear documentation of all parameters and output fields.
- Requires: baostock, pandas, numpy.
